SELECT fr.flight_reserveSdate AS flight_reserveSdate, frm.flight_user_id AS flight_user_id, frm.flight_reno AS flight_reno, frm.flight_mem_firstName AS flight_mem_firstName, frm.flight_mem_lastName AS flight_mem_lastName, fi.flight_info_airline AS flight_info_airline, fi.flight_info_startCity AS flight_info_startCity, fi.flight_info_startTime AS flight_info_startTime, fi.flight_info_arrivalCity AS flight_info_arrivalCity, fi.flight_info_arrivalTime AS flight_info_arrivalTime, fi.flight_distance AS flight_distance, frm.flight_mem_start_seatNum AS flight_mem_start_seatNum, frm.flight_mem_arrive_seatNum AS flight_mem_arrive_seatNum, frm.flight_passport AS flight_passport, frm.flight_mem_luggage AS flight_mem_luggage, frm.flight_start_payCheck AS flight_start_payCheck, frm.flight_arr_payCheck AS flight_arr_payCheck, fi.flight_id AS flight_id,
CASE WHEN fr.flight_start_id = fi.flight_id THEN frm.flight_mem_start_seatNum WHEN fr.flight_arr_id = fi.flight_id THEN frm.flight_mem_arrive_seatNum ELSE '없음' END AS selected_seat,
CASE WHEN fr.flight_start_id = fi.flight_id THEN frm.flight_mem_start_price WHEN fr.flight_arr_id = fi.flight_id THEN frm.flight_mem_arr_price ELSE 0 END AS selected_price
FROM flight_reserve_member frm JOIN flight_reserve fr ON frm.flight_reno = fr.flight_reno JOIN flight_info fi ON fr.flight_start_id = fi.flight_id OR fr.flight_arr_id = fi.flight_id WHERE fr.flight_user_id = #{userMemId} AND (frm.flight_start_payCheck = 'N' OR frm.flight_arr_payCheck = 'N')
